title: D2P Print Job Spec
description: Derived document and the only renderer input (design decisions ADR-022, ADR-022.1). It embeds the complete export scene, fixes scale 1 (no fit-to-page, ever) and states media, margins, tiling, calibration and the print notice. Media dimensions are always the portrait dimensions; orientation rotates the sheet. The tile grid covers the union of piece-instance bounding boxes, its origin is the top-left corner of the layout box; the horizontal step is the sheet width minus left and right margins minus overlapMm (vertical likewise), columns = max(1, ceil((layoutWidth - overlapMm) / step)) (rows likewise); sheets are labelled <row letter><column number> (A1, A2, ..., B1, ...), rows top to bottom, columns left to right. Printer margins are device facts and MUST be stated; the standard provides no default. Semantic rules: D2P-SEM-091 (calibration for home-print and plotter profiles), D2P-SEM-092 (named media dimensions), D2P-SEM-095 (binding page properties of the home-print output profiles), D2P-SEM-050 (no personal data); conformance profile d2p:print-v1.

documentType.description: Document type discriminator of this schema.

schemaVersion.description: Full SemVer of the standard release this document was written against.

printJobId.description: Own ID of this print job (prefix pjs_). Excluded from resultDigest.

scene.description: The complete export scene, embedded with its own header and copied verbatim. Its schemaVersion MUST equal this document's schemaVersion (D2P-STR-003).

scale.description: Print scale; always exactly 1 (no fit-to-page, ever).

calibration.description: Calibration control square. Required for d2p:home-print-a4, d2p:home-print-a3 and d2p:plotter-1to1 (semantic rule D2P-SEM-091, not schema-enforced). Absent means no control square.

printNotice.description: Notice printed on every sheet instructing printing at 100 % / actual size.

conformance.description: The d2p:print-v1 conformance level the producer claims for this job.

provenance.description: Generator and the digest of the embedded scene.

requiredExtensions.description: Extension namespaces a renderer MUST understand (equivalent to onUnknown: reject; D2P-SEM-006 when unsupported). Omitted when empty. Ordered by string value.

resultDigest.description: Digest of this document per digest profile d2p-digest-v1, excluding contentDigest, resultDigest, printJobId and every top-level member ending in 'At'.

contentDigest.description: Optional digest of the whole document excluding contentDigest itself (d2p-digest-v1).

extensions.description: Optional extension blocks keyed by extension namespace.

outputProfile.title: Output profile
outputProfile.description: Identifies the output profile and its version. The d2p: profiles are defined by the schema catalog (version 1.0.0): d2p:home-print-a4 and d2p:home-print-a3 require media iso-a4 respectively iso-a3, tiling mode tiled with overlapMm > 0, registrationMarks and sheetLabels true and a label on a d2p:label layer per piece instance (D2P-SEM-095), and a calibration square (D2P-SEM-091); d2p:plotter-1to1 requires a calibration square.

profileId.description: Output profile (extensible vocabulary): d2p:home-print-a4, d2p:home-print-a3, d2p:plotter-1to1, d2p:vector-svg, or an extension name.

pageLayout.title: Page layout
pageLayout.description: Sheet media, orientation, printer margins and tiling.

orientation.description: Sheet orientation; 'landscape' rotates the portrait media.

marginsMm.description: Non-printable printer margins in mm (device facts, no default).

tiling.description: Tiling of the layout over several sheets.

media.title: Media
media.description: Sheet size, always stated in portrait dimensions. Named media MUST match ISO 216 (A4 = 210 x 297 mm, A3 = 297 x 420 mm; D2P-SEM-092, not schema-enforced).

margins.title: Margins
margins.description: Printer margins in mm, relative to the oriented sheet.

tiling.title: Tiling
tiling.description: Tiling mode. overlapMm is required when mode = 'tiled' and forbidden when mode = 'none' (schema-enforced, D2P-STR-001).

mode.description: 'none': a single sheet; 'tiled': the layout is split over a grid of sheets.

overlapMm.description: Overlap between adjacent tiles in mm.

registrationMarks.description: True if registration marks are printed for assembling the tiles.

sheetLabels.description: True if sheet labels (A1, A2, ..., B1, ...) are printed.

calibration.title: Calibration
calibration.description: Control square used to verify the printed scale.

controlSquareMm.description: Edge length of the control square in mm; always 100.

placement.description: Whether the control square is printed on every sheet or on the first sheet only.

printNotice.title: Print notice
printNotice.description: Text printed on every sheet. It MUST instruct printing at 100 % / actual size.

locale.description: BCP 47 language tag of the notice text.

printConformance.title: Print conformance claim
printConformance.description: The conformance profile and the cumulative level (parse < geometry < print) the producer claims.

printProvenance.title: Print provenance
printProvenance.description: Software that generated the job and the digest of the embedded scene.

generator.description: Name and version of the generating software.

sceneDigest.description: MUST equal the embedded scene's resultDigest (D2P-REF-011 when it differs).
